endorsements.name: Andy Winiarski
endorsements.label: Identity Security Blindspots – Closing the Gaps in Your IAM Perimeter
endorsements.description: Identity has become the frontline in the battle with cyber adversaries, but it is NOT a traditional perimeter at all – certainly not in today’s distributed, dynamic landscape. Each IAM platform has hidden capabilities and shortcomings that need to be examined to get a full picture of identity risk. Join me for a fast-paced, case study based discussion of identity loopholes and IOCs, and approaches to close them with methods you may not know existed.
